raw.buffDescription: Using the Dexterity Mastery to avoid an attack grants the Attacker a Fury Charge, increasing their Attack Rating by 5% per Charge. At 10 Fury Charges all Charges are lost and the Defender’s attacks are Passively Unblockable for 15 seconds. These effects cannot be prevented by Ability Accuracy modification.
